title: Resolution normalization for arbitrary module injective resolutions
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], module F on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], degree p in the natural numbers and x in module cohomology [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], the fixed equivalence [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] sends x to the unique abelian Ext class whose image under the explicit abelianResolutionIso(X,I,p) equals moduleResolutionIso(X,I,p)(x). The latter is the module derived-resolution comparison followed by forgetting homology. The former is Ext precomposition by terminalSourceIso, the concrete Ext/derived-sections comparison, and the canonical acyclic-resolution comparison on the forgotten augmentation of I. Both isomorphisms are constructed, and no map of schemes or edge map enters the assertion.

proof.text: Lift the identity from the standard module injective resolution to I. Naturality of isoRightDerivedObj and of exact forgetting through mapHomologyIso shows that moduleResolutionIso commutes with the induced section-homology map.

Apply acyclicComparison_naturality to the forgotten identity lift and the two forgotten augmentations. Forgotten injective terms are section-acyclic. Composing with the inverses of the acyclic comparison isomorphisms shows that abelianResolutionIso commutes with the same section-homology map.
For the standard resolution the fixed equivalence is moduleResolutionIso followed by inverse abelianResolutionIso, by its construction. Compose the two change-of-resolution equalities to conclude.

theorem moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv_normalization
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F) :
    (abelianResolutionIso X I p).hom (moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv X F p x) =
      (moduleResolutionIso X I p).hom x
